chapters.title: Opening
sentences: Once upon a time when pigs spoke rhyme, and monkeys chewed tobacco, and hens took snuff to make them tough, and ducks went quack, quack, quack, O!
There was an old sow with three little pigs, and as she had not enough to keep them, she sent them out to seek their fortune.
The first that went off met a man with a bundle of straw, and said to him, “Please, man, give me that straw to build me a house.”
Which the man did, and the little pig built a house with it.
